The [[Kurzick Ambassador]] will align your [[guild]] with the [[Kurzick]]s for 500 {{gold}}.

==Locations==
*[[Echovald Forest]]
**{{NPC location|House zu Heltzer}}

==Dialogue==
If unaligned:
:''"As the leader of <[[Guild]] name>, you may pledge your [[alliance]] to join the Kurzick cause. If you fight well enough, you may be given command over territories that fall into Kurzick hands. Are you ready to make such a commitment? Then repeat after me.''
:''We, <Guild name>, recognizing the greatness of the Kurzick nation, do pledge our support to all the [[Great House|Houses of Echovald]], promising to neither favor one over another nor to neglect the needs of the whole for the needs of the one.''
:''I, <[[Character]] name>, as leader of my alliance, do make this oath for myself and for those that follow me."''
:{{yes|ingame}} '''Accept'''
::''"One last thing. To properly present your petition, a small expenditure is required. 500 gold should be sufficient."''
::{{yes|ingame}} '''Accept'''
::{{no|ingame}} '''Decline'''
:{{no|ingame}} '''Decline'''

If aligned with the Luxons, as alliance leader:
:''"As leader of <Alliance name>, you speak for your entire alliance. It is not too late to break your ties to the [[Luxon]]s and pledge yourselves to the Kurzicks. Are you ready to make such a commitment? Then repeat after me:''
:''We, <Alliance name>, do disavow our former ties to the accursed Luxons. May [[Grenth]] take them all! We pledge now to cast aside our former ties and to be forever loyal to the Kurzick nation. We shall support all the Houses of Echovald, promising to favor neither one over another nor to neglect the needs of the whole for the needs of the one.''
:''I, <Character name>, as leader of my alliance, do make this oath for myself and for those that follow me."''
:{{yes|ingame}} '''Accept'''
::''"One last thing. To properly present your petition, a small expenditure is required. 500 gold should be sufficient."''
::{{yes|ingame}} '''Accept'''
::{{no|ingame}} '''Decline'''
:{{no|ingame}} '''Decline'''

If aligned with the Luxons and and you are not the guild leader:
:''"Get out of my sight before I have you killed! I know that your alliance serves the Luxons."''

If already aligned with the Kurzicks:
:''"Hello, <Character name>. Your alliance has already pledged its loyalty to the Kurzicks. If you wish to improve the position of your alliance, talk to the [[Kurzick Scribe|Scribe]]. Alliances with the greatest reputation are granted territories to control. If you wish to do battle against the Luxons, talk to the [[Kurzick Kommandant|Kommandant]]. Victory will allow us to protect more territory.''
:''May the gods watch over you."''

==Notes==
*You must be a [[guild leader]] in order to join an [[allegiance]].
*Your guild must not be in an [[alliance]] in order to join an allegiance.
*The Scribe NPC mentioned in Ambassador's dialogue was removed from the game in the [[game updates/20070615|June 15, 2007 update]].
